events.rationale: New user-visible functionality (admin panel, credential login) skips design because all UI patterns are already established in existing pages — Admin panel follows AlertHistory layout, no novel components needed. Skips architecture because the auth pattern is already in place (ProtectedRoute exists), admin is a straightforward role check on the existing context, and all changes are confined to 6 files in a single subsystem.

events.decision: Auth context starts unauthenticated (useState(false)) and login() validates credentials against a mockUsers array
events.rationale: The current useState(true) stub exists only to unblock UI development. Making it false is the minimum change to enforce the login gate without touching any other route logic — ProtectedRoute already does the right thing once the initial state is correct.

events.decision: Admin protection is a new AdminRoute guard in App.jsx, not an extension of ProtectedRoute
events.rationale: ProtectedRoute only checks isAuthenticated. Admin protection additionally checks currentUser.role. Keeping them separate preserves the single-responsibility principle and avoids adding a prop to every non-admin ProtectedRoute call.

Workflow: scope → implementation → review → release (design and architecture skipped — existing UI patterns cover the admin panel, auth pattern already established).
